principles: Oil-related tanker classification is based on reported ship category.
Tanker size classification uses reported DWT.
AIS absence is not evidence of physical vessel absence.
AIS suppression, GPS jamming, dark transit and coverage gaps may affect observations.
No physical oil throughput is calculated from this snapshot.
No final Hormuz risk score is calculated here.

data_quality.interpretation: Quality describes the usability of the vessel-level AIS snapshot. It does not measure physical oil-flow accuracy.

integration.next_step: Validate the vessel endpoint structure and identifiers, then add snapshot history and run-to-run vessel movement detection.
